backspace_assignment_display_followup.observation: Backspace was displayed as the SELECT assignment, while physical SELECT/Backspace was not accepted in the tested Delta input/mapping flow.
backspace_assignment_display_followup.distinction: A displayed assignment does not establish successful live input handling. Whether this was a default or previously saved assignment, and whether Backspace worked previously in this environment, is unconfirmed.

source_history.finding: Introduced modern GCKeyboard handling for Apple Silicon Macs; other platforms retained legacy handling.
Enabled modern handling on iOS 26 because legacy handling no longer worked.

backspace_assignment_display_followup.inference: A missing Backspace conversion in the modern path exposed by the iOS 26 switch is a leading hypothesis, rather than an established intentional prohibition of Backspace. Displayed mapping, working Safari input, and successful Tab workaround are consistent with this hypothesis.
backspace_assignment_display_followup.limits: No runtime button description/branch capture or comparison on older Delta/iOS versions. Does not prove exact cause, recent regression, previous Backspace success, or official acknowledgement of a bug.
backspace_assignment_display_followup.action: Keep the verified SELECT-to-Tab mapping; no firmware change or further physical test required for this documentation update.
